title: Microsoft Flight Simulator 2024
provenance: community report with a full teardown (highball-db#6, Michael-Liendo), unverified by Highball
notes: Does not launch. On the default D3DMetal path the game refuses to start with 'Your graphics card does not support Shader Model 6.7'; D3DMetal tops out at Shader Model 6.6. The reporter confirmed the D3DMetal libraries Highball ships are byte-identical to CrossOver's, so no Wine wrapper changes this. Replacing the translation chain (vkd3d-proton plus DXVK in place of D3DMetal) does clear that ceiling and reaches Shader Model 6.8, which works on Highball's MoltenVK 1.4.1 but not on CrossOver's older MoltenVK. The sim then boots and renders about 55 frames of its loading screen before hanging in its own fiber scheduler. Still missing after that: null descriptors and robustBufferAccess2, which are implementable, and tiled resources tier 2, which Apple GPUs do not have. That last one closes the door on this title for now. Full teardown, including the patches, in the issue.
